build_fbnet_block_from_registry: use the PRIMITIVES registry to build an IRF block by name with given channels and stride
create_conv_bn_relu_block: create a ConvBNRelu block with kernel size 3 using the conv_k3 primitive factory
build_irf_residual_block: build an inverted residual bottleneck block with squeeze-and-excitation using the ir_k3_se primitive
create_pooling_block: create a max pooling or average pooling block using the maxpool or avgpool primitive factory
register_custom_primitive: register a custom block factory lambda into the PRIMITIVES registry for use in FBNet model construction
